Select the first 200 rows from the metabolism table joined to substrate compound records and structures. Use the mandatory substrate join path: metabolism.substrate_record_id -> compound_records.record_id -> compound_structures.molregno. Retrieve canonical SMILES from compound_structures. Retrieve substrate compound name from compound_records.compound_name. Retrieve parent compound name from molecule_dictionary.pref_name by joining molecule_hierarchy on the substrate molregno to reach parent_molregno. Retrieve metabolic conversion and pathway key from metabolism. Do not deduplicate rows. Do not add sorting. Return exactly canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, and pathway_key.
